notes.title: Update for Taste of Power
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We have released an update for Taste of Power.
It finalized the system of balances and changed the characteristics of a number of troops. Improved artificial intelligence and fixed a some of errors that arose earlier.

Best regards,
Taste of Power Team

notes.title: Game Release News
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/1ba8b81b872e953d51a7628af18e156aec9fb7ed.png[/img]

Greetings! 

Very little time is left before the early access to the Taste of Power is over.
We keep working on a campaign for the game, interface improvement and tweaking of game mechanics. For this, we need a little more time.


We are planning the release for the second half of September, 2019. 

Taste of Power Team.

notes.title: Update of the warfare mechanics
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/86ab07a641872954d5fed27677c7d019d93c2b45.jpg[/img]

Hello friends!
Over the past month we have focused on improving the warfare mechanics.
We have improved the squad management. Now they almost never overlap each other. As a result, the battles have become even more ambitious, and the control of the positioning of your troops is even more important now.


We continue working on the multiplayer. We will try and add it in the nearest future.

Help us become better - write in the comments on what you think of the current changes and what has to be improved or added in the nearest future.

notes.title: Taste of Power March Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31510811/28d452733bdb3163f7a2bb8d95cf94108a4daa0c.png[/img]

Greetings!

Today an update for early access to the Taste of Power has been released.

The third game side of the Timurids appeared in it. It is represented by the warriors of the Middle East. War elephants, chariots with incendiary oils, engineers who can build underground tunnels and a lot more will be under your control.

In April we will present an update where a new "Survival" mode will appear.

notes.title: The new update of the free demo.
notes.notes:
We have updated the free demo of the game.
The main emphasis was placed on the level design. You have already seen the screenshots of the updated map and now you can play on it.
In addition, we finalized the mechanics of the battle, making it more dynamic. And changed the approach to the training system: now the hints appear during the game and make the acquaintance with the game more simple and understandable.

We really appreciate your feedback on the improvements. Write them in the discussion on Steam!
